text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on the way back to campus after a
day out
with Wonder Acute, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My stomach rumbles. It must be from all
the
walking we did today.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You must be famished for your
tum-tum
to growl so loud, dear. Should
we stop for
something to eat?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We step into a nearby restaurant, where
we run
into two other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Are you two here for the seasonal apple
pie too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal apple pie? Why, I had no idea
they had
such a thing.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It looks delicious. I might need to order
myself a
slice. What about you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seasonal items are just too enticing. I
end up
buying a slice for myself as well
as Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mmm! ♪ It's so soft and chewy and
warm
and delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: And don't forget the smell. What is that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It does smell good, doesn't it? I think it's
nutmeg.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Nutmeg? That's, like, a spice, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I believe it is, dearie. It's used quite
often in
desserts because of its sweet
aroma.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's a tad bitter, though, so it's better
suited to
adults.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I remember one time I gave some
nutmeg cookies
to the elderly folks on
the town council back in
the day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
They seemed to really like them... They
ate them
up like hotcakes, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can practically see it. I guess
flavor really
is tied to memory!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I guess so. Just thinking back on it
makes me all
warm and toasty.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Now that I think about it, that
cherry pie
must've had nutmeg in it too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A loooong time ago, my family and I ate
this
remarkable cherry pie at a bakery.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The cherries were tart, sweet, and
gooey. The
crust was nice and flaky. And
the whole pie had
the faint scent of
nutmeg...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It really is a spice that makes you feel
warm and
cozy. Now I want to eat it
again!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hehe. If you liked it, it must've been good!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Totally! It sounds like the kind of pie
that would
brighten your life! I wanna try
it too! I bet you do
too, huh, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Really? That's so nice to hear.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That said, I don't remember where the
shop was.
It was just so long ago.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still... wouldn't it be nice if we could all
eat it
together someday?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Still... wouldn't it be nice if we could all
eat it
together someday?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Well, it's certainly possible.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And if it means we can all eat it
together, I say it's
worth a shot.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just promise you'll be nice if it doesn't
come out
tasting like anything special.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'm just used to making pies, is all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Cinnamon, nutmeg, and clove are all
common
ingredients in baking, so I can
generally pick
them out with just a whiff.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Call it wisdom born of experience. Hehe.
